about_the_game:
Play as a bio-organic superweapon designed to look like a little girl who escapes government control to live a human life… only to find danger follows her everywhere.

Engage in fast-paced third-person combat combining guns and swords. Lost limbs regenerate in real time, forcing you to adapt your strategy on the fly. Launch enemies off-screen with explosive kicks or finish them with over-the-top combos for satisfying, stylized action.

Key Features:

  • Stylized, Pixar-inspired visuals with exaggerated, over-the-top action

  • Dynamic limb regeneration system that changes combat strategy

  • Intense, stylized violence with frequent blood and exploding limbs

  • Directional 3D audio for immersive combat awareness

  • Single-player story with cinematic cutscenes

For fans of action-packed shooters, cinematic storytelling, and over-the-top combat, Spirit Trigger delivers a thrilling ride from start to finish.

content_descriptors.notes: Stylized, cartoonish violence with frequent blood and dismemberment. Exploding limbs and intense combat are common, but all in a non-realistic, over-the-top style. No sexual content or drug use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti/RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5-11400/Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060/GTX 1660 Ti/RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
